title: THE GARDEN
style: natural light landscape photography, soft golden hour, gentle haze, muted greens and warm neutrals, shallow depth of field, high detail

music.tags: low drone, dissonant sustained strings, sparse metallic hits, unsettling, instrumental

beats.prompt: A bare winter allotment with dark empty soil, grey morning light, wide shot, nothing growing
beats.motion: Mist drifts low across the soil.
beats.caption: Monday: nothing but frost

line.text: On Monday there was nothing here but frost and dark soil.

beats.prompt: A close-up of a green shoot pushing through dark earth, macro, soft light, high detail
beats.motion: The shoot rises very slowly through the soil.
beats.caption: Wednesday: at the fence

line.text: By Tuesday there were shoots. By Wednesday they were at the fence.

beats.prompt: A dense overgrown garden swallowing a shed, green and wild, soft light, slightly wrong scale
beats.caption: Friday: the shed is gone

line.text: It is Friday. The shed is gone.

beats.prompt: A wall of dense green growth filling the frame, close-up, soft light, faintly ominous
beats.motion: The leaves shift and settle, as if breathing.
